name: GB/T 20234.2 AC
description: Chinese national AC charging coupler defined by GB/T 20234.2, rated up to 440 V AC, 50 Hz and 63 A. Seven contacts: three lines, neutral, protective earth, charging connection confirmation (CC) and control pilot (CP). Unlike IEC 62196 Type 2, the vehicle inlet carries contact tubes and the cable-side vehicle connector carries pins.

standards.title: Connection set for conductive charging of electric vehicles – Part 2: AC charging coupler
standards.scope: Ratings (Table 1), contact functions (Table 2), contact arrangement and dimensions of the vehicle coupler and supply coupler in charging mode 3. Replaces GB/T 20234.2-2011; still the current edition (no 2023 revision of Part 2 was published).

relations.note: Similar seven-position face with a flat top edge, but genders are reversed (female vehicle inlet, male vehicle connector) and CC takes the place of PP. Not treated as interchangeable.

L2 and L3 are fitted on three-phase inlets; single-phase inlets use L1 and N.

electricalProfiles.name: AC single-phase
conditions: Secondary sources give 250 V with 10, 16 or 32 A for single-phase use; GB/T 20234.2-2015 Table 1 itself was not reviewed.
Single-phase charging uses contacts L1 and N.
CC is the charging connection confirmation contact; it is recorded as proximity_pilot, the closest function in the OpenPlugDB vocabulary.

electricalProfiles.name: AC three-phase
conditions: 440 V AC, 50 Hz and 63 A are the upper limits of the scope of GB/T 20234.2-2015; reading 440 V as line-to-line is an interpretation for three-phase use.
The 2015 edition raised the maximum rated current from 32 A to 63 A, added 10 A and 63 A to the rated currents and extended the spare contacts to three-phase charging.
Secondary sources give 440 V with 16, 32 or 63 A for charging mode 3; Table 1 itself was not reviewed.
CC is the charging connection confirmation contact; it is recorded as proximity_pilot, the closest function in the OpenPlugDB vocabulary.

notes: GB/T 20234.2-2015 Tables 1 and 2 (rated values and contact ratings) were not reviewed; the single-phase 250 V rating and the per-mode current steps come from secondary sources.

Contact genders per part (male vehicle connector and supply plug, female vehicle inlet and supply socket-outlet) rest on a single secondary source (Wikipedia); the inlet face layout, a mirror of the Type 2 inlet layout, is consistent with a female inlet.

The inlet face drawing relies on a single manufacturer source (Phoenix Contact 1271831). The vehicle connector, supply plug and supply socket-outlet faces are not drawn: no source depicting them was reviewed.
No 2023 revision of GB/T 20234.2 exists in the national catalogue as of the access date; Parts 1, 3 and 4 were revised in 2023.
The OpenStreetMap socket key for GB/T AC could not be checked against the pinned wiki revision; the mapping is left empty pending that check, not because no key exists.
The proximity resistor coding of the CC contact (cable current capability) is not recorded: GB/T 18487.1 was not reviewed.
